columns.name: risk_grant_id
columns.type: TEXT REFERENCES risk_grants(risk_grant_id) ON DELETE SET NULL

portfolio_allocations.name: portfolio_allocations
table_constraints: CHECK (max_capital IS NULL OR max_capital >= allocated_capital)

order_group_event_inbox.name: order_group_event_inbox
table_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (group_id, leg_id) REFERENCES conditional_order_group_legs(group_id, leg_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

execution_command_outbox.name: execution_command_outbox
table_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (group_id, leg_id) REFERENCES conditional_order_group_legs(group_id, leg_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

command_journal.name: command_journal
table_constraints: CHECK (outcome_class IS NULL OR outcome_class IN ( 'ACCEPTED', 'BUSINESS_REJECTED', 'RETRYABLE', 'UNCERTAIN', 'TERMINAL' ))

command_broker_attempts.name: command_broker_attempts
table_constraints: CHECK (outcome_class IS NULL OR outcome_class IN ( 'ACCEPTED', 'BUSINESS_REJECTED', 'RETRYABLE', 'UNCERTAIN', 'TERMINAL' ))

engine_shadow_comparisons.name: engine_shadow_comparisons
table_constraints: CHECK (matches OR divergence_reason IS NOT NULL)

engine_authority_scopes.name: engine_authority_scopes
table_constraints: CHECK (shadow_backend IS NULL OR shadow_backend IN ('PYTHON', 'RUST'))

CHECK ( (rollout_state = 'PYTHON_AUTHORITATIVE' AND authoritative_backend = 'PYTHON' AND shadow_backend IS NULL) OR (rollout_state = 'PYTHON_WITH_RUST_SHADOW' AND authoritative_backend = 'PYTHON' AND shadow_backend = 'RUST') OR (rollout_state IN ( 'RUST_WITH_PYTHON_SHADOW_PAPER_CANARY', 'RUST_AUTHORITATIVE_PAPER_SCOPE' ) AND authoritative_backend = 'RUST' AND shadow_backend = 'PYTHON') OR (rollout_state = 'SANDBOX_PREFLIGHT_CANARY' AND authoritative_backend = 'PYTHON' AND shadow_backend = 'RUST') )

engine_authority_decisions.name: engine_authority_decisions
table_constraints: CHECK (shadow_backend IS NULL OR shadow_backend IN ('PYTHON', 'RUST'))

CHECK ( (state = 'EVALUATING' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'DECIDED' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_output IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_decision_digest IS NOT NULL) OR (state = 'FAILED' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND failure_reason IS NOT NULL) )
CHECK (matches IS NULL OR shadow_backend IS NOT NULL)

maintenance_policy_registry.name: maintenance_policy_registry
table_constraints: CHECK (retention_interval IS NULL OR retention_interval > INTERVAL '0 seconds')

broker_sync_valuation_history.name: broker_sync_valuation_history
table_constraints: PRIMARY KEY (scope_type, scope_key, mode, venue, bucket_start)
